description: Read the latest 1000 access attempts for an owned grant, including refused downloads. Use this to see whether a share was opened. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

grant_id.description: grant_id of the share to audit.

name: get_access_log
title: Get access log
